title: Extension adjunction unit on a K-flat affine sections model
statement: Let $R,B$ be commutative rings, $g:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ a morphism, and $M$ an unbounded K-flat complex of $R$-modules [def-pc-module-kflat-complex]. Use the affine functors and fixed extension adjunction of [def-pc-affine-global-hom-base-change-map] and the associated-sheaf functor of [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], with their additive structures. Set $K=\widetilde M$, $X=\Gamma_R K$, $Z=R\Gamma_R(QK)$, $E=B\otimes_R-$ and $U$ restriction of scalars. There are isomorphisms $s:Z\simeq QX$ and $a:LE(Z)\simeq Q(EX)$ such that $s^{-1}$ is the canonical ordinary-to-derived affine sections comparison, and $\eta_{LE\dashv U}(Z)\,U(a)=s\,Q(\eta_{E\dashv U}(X))\,\kappa_U^{-1}(EX)$, where $\kappa_U$ is the exact-restriction localization comparison. The comparisons and equation are specified verbatim in lean.statement. No tensor pullback, v, r or comparison c is required.

source.place: Tags 06Z0 (lemma-affine-compare-bounded), 08DV (lemma-affine-K-flat), 08DW(2) (lemma-quasi-coherence-pullback), and 0AA7 (lemma-affine-morphism-and-hom-out-of-perfect); normalized derived adjunction unit calculation

proof.text: Construct eX:M ≅ X degreewise from tilde.isoTop; naturality of tilde.toTildeΓNatIso proves compatibility with differentials. Transport categorical K-flatness along eX. Apply affineTildeDerivedSectionsUnit_isIso to the homotopy image of M, and compose this invertible comparison with quotientCompQhIso and affineGlobalSectionsDerivedIso. Its inverse is s and its inverse formula is definitional.

Install PreservesKFlatQuasiIso for ordinary extension. Apply the first clause of mixedTensor_kFlat_quasiIso with the B tensor unit in degree zero. The map₂HomologicalComplexFlipObjSingleIso and extension of the left unitor identify this map with termwise extension of the given quasi-isomorphism. Transport QuasiIso across the two arrow isomorphisms. The standard derived extension adjunction with exact restriction is then defined. Its K-flat counit ε on X is invertible; compose the quotient/homotopy comparisons with asIso ε to obtain d.

Construct the unit-compatible uniqueness isomorphism e from the fixed extension adjunction to the standard derived adjunction. Put a=LE(s) followed by e and d. Apply derivedη_fac_app to the extension homotopy adjunction. Postcompose with the exact restriction derived-functor isomorphism; its unit compatibility cancels the restriction unit and gives the ordinary unit equation on Qh(X). The explicit mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh formula, naturality of quotientCompQhIso, and the HomotopyCategory adjunction unit formula convert this to the equation on Q(X). Naturality of the fixed extension unit for s.hom followed by unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app gives the stated equation on Z. The construction and all cancellations are written in Lean.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineExtension_model_unit
    {R B : CommRingCat.{u}} (g : Spec B ⟶ Spec R)
    [(@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)).Additive]
    [(ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (affineBaseRingMap g)).Additive]
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ)
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} R) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M) :
    let T := @Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} R ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec R).toRingedSpace))
        (tilde.functor R)) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)
    let K := T.obj M
    let X := ((affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K
    let Z := (affineDerivedGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K)
    let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} (affineBaseRingMap g)
    let U := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} (affineBaseRingMap g)
    ∃ (s : Z ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj X)
      (a : (affineDerivedExtension g).obj Z ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X)),
      s.inv =
        (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app X ≫
          (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
          (affineGlobalSections (𝟙 (Spec R))).rightDerivedFunctor.map
            ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app K) ≫
          (affineGlobalSectionsDerivedIso (𝟙 (Spec R))).hom.app
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ∧
      (affineDerivedExtensionAdjunction g).unit.app Z ≫ U.mapDerivedCategory.map a.hom =
        s.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
          (((ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (affineBaseRingMap g)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).unit.app X) ≫
          U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X)
